caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher, rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite, positioned centrally within a rectangular border on a light, off-white background. The pitcher has an elongated, bulbous lower body that tapers down to a slender stem and sits on a round, faceted base. The top features a wide, outward-flared spout on the left, and a long, upright, curved handle that extends high above the pitcher’s body on the right. There is engraved detailing along the upper edge of the pitcher and a circular area with ornate script lettering at the center of the body. The shading indicates reflective surfaces and gives the pitcher a three-dimensional appearance. The artist’s signature, “G. Capelli,” is located in the bottom right corner inside the border.
title: Silver Pitcher
